summary: Constellation Energy Generation LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus for an exchange offer, swapping up to $2.29 billion aggregate principal of three series of outstanding unregistered senior notes (4.625% 2029s, 5.000% 2031s, 3.750% 2031s) for like principal amounts of new registered notes with identical terms except transfer restrictions. The offers expire June 24, 2026; no proceeds are received, and outstanding debt does not increase. This is a standard registered exchange to improve liquidity, not a special situation. What to watch: no material event expected.
